E.headline: GPT-3 weights what something is for above what it is made of and its appearance; BLOOM's pattern is weaker and mixed.

G.notes: The human side is borrowed from published studies, with no human data on the new vignettes. Different GPT-3 checkpoints serve the replications (curie) and the experiments (davinci). Temperature is missing for the curie runs. Free-text answers were coded with GPT-3 itself. BLOOM mostly answers 'unsure'. Only one model per vendor in the experiments.
